title: Total Stock Value
flavorText: SUM() adds up a column of numbers. Multiply price by stock for each row, then sum the result — total inventory value.
narrative: The Bureau needs to know the total monetary value of all stock.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL, stock INTEGER NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Datapad','Electronics',299.99,45),(2,'Power Cell','Electronics',19.99,200),(3,'Steel Cable','Hardware',8.50,500),(4,'Logic Board','Electronics',89.99,30),(5,'Ceramic Fuse','Hardware',2.25,1000),(6,'Optic Lens','Optics',149.99,15),(7,'Servo Motor','Robotics',55.00,80),(8,'Pressure Valve','Hardware',12.75,300);
task: Calculate the total inventory value (sum of price × stock for all products).

hints.text: SUM() adds up numeric values. You can sum an expression, not just a column: SUM(price * stock).
SELECT SUM(price * stock) FROM products; — give it an alias.
SELECT SUM(price * stock) AS total_value FROM products;
